rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for benevolent concern and charitable giving.

example.english: Philanthropy isn't only for wealthy people; everyone can contribute.
example.traditional: 慈善唔係有錢人先做得，人人都可以出一分力。
example.jyutping: ci4 sin6 m4 hai6 jau5 cin2 jan4 sin1 zou6 dak1 jan4 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 ceot1 jat1 fan1 lik6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a charitable foundation or foundation organization.

example.english: The philanthropy foundation funds local environmental projects every year.
example.traditional: 慈善基金會每年都會資助本地嘅環保項目。
example.jyutping: ci4 sin6 gei1 gam1 wui5 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui6 zi1 zo6 bun2 dei6 ge3 waan4 bou2 hong6 muk6

rows.note: Use this for a particular charitable deed or philanthropic act.

example.english: Donating supplies to the disaster victims was truly an act of philanthropy.
example.traditional: 你今次捐物資畀災民，真係一個善舉。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 ci3 gyun1 mat6 zi1 bei2 zoi1 man4 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 sin6 geoi2
